backlog.label: Backlog
backlog.hint: Parked. Assigning an agent here never starts it.

todo.label: Todo
todo.hint: Queued. A task here with an agent starts that agent — the most urgent first.

in_progress.label: In progress
in_progress.hint: The agent is working on it.

blocked.label: Blocked
blocked.hint: Stalled: the agent needs something, the run failed or was stopped, or publishing didn't work.

done.label: Done
done.hint: Completed. Set automatically when the pull request merges.

general.label: Task
general.hint: The agent does it and reports back.

coding.label: Coding
coding.hint: Works on its own branch and worktree, opens a pull request.

research.label: Research
research.hint: The agent investigates and writes a report.

work.pausedUser: {{name}} picks the work up where it stopped.
work.pausedAuto: {{name}} continues by itself {{when}}, where it stopped.
work.limitResets: The limit resets {{when}} — continue it then.
work.continueWhenReset: Continue it when the limit has reset.
work.cancelFollowupHint: {{name}} won't continue on its own — the task goes to In review
work.timedOut: It hit the run's time limit. Try again, or split the task into smaller ones.
work.interrupted: Godmode restarted while {{name}} was working. It continues in the same chat, with what it did so far.
work.assignToGoOn: Assign an agent to go on.
work.branchPushed: Branch pushed — open the pull request on {{host}}
work.mergesInto: Merges #{{number}} into {{branch}} on {{host}} and moves the ticket to Done.
work.waitsFor_one: Waits for {{list}} — {{name}} starts by itself once it is delivered, with its result.
work.waitsFor_other: Waits for {{list}} — {{name}} starts by itself once they are delivered, with their result.
work.assignStarts: Assign an agent — it starts right away.
work.assignAndMove: Assign an agent and move it to Todo to start it.

card.queued: Queued — waiting for a free slot

restored.you: {{a}} put it back on the board
restored.other: {{a}} put it back on the board

retryMore.you: {{a}} tried once more on its own
retryMore.other: {{a}} tried once more on its own

retry.you: {{a}} tried again on its own after the run failed
retry.other: {{a}} tried again on its own after the run failed

heartbeat.you: {{a}} picked it up on its heartbeat
heartbeat.other: {{a}} picked it up on its heartbeat

pickedUpSubtasks.you_one: {{a}} picked it up again — {{list}} is done
pickedUpSubtasks.you_other: {{a}} picked it up again — {{list}} are done
pickedUpSubtasks.other_one: {{a}} picked it up again — {{list}} is done
pickedUpSubtasks.other_other: {{a}} picked it up again — {{list}} are done

event.branchPushed: Branch pushed — the pull request still has to be opened

timeline.goneAgent: An agent that no longer exists
timeline.title: Activity

archived.emptyDescription: Archive finished work to keep the board focused: right-click a card, or clear a whole Done column from its header. Archived tasks keep everything and come back in one click.

goals.label: Goals
goals.intro: Goals say what the work is for — tickets that serve one tell their agent why, and you see how far it is.
goals.deletedDescription: Its tickets stay, serving no goal.
goals.deleteDescription_one: Its ticket stays, serving no goal. To keep it on record, mark it achieved or drop it instead.
goals.deleteDescription_other: Its {{count}} tickets stay, serving no goal. To keep it on record, mark it achieved or drop it instead.
goals.deleteDescriptionEmpty: No ticket serves it yet. To keep it on record, mark it achieved or drop it instead.
goals.addedDescription: File tickets under it — their agents are told why.
goals.dialogDescription: What the work is for. Tickets that serve it tell their agent why.
goals.whyPlaceholder: Raise revenue per customer by 20% this quarter — the agents get this with every ticket.

fix.filedMerge: The fix goes into {{branch}} once it's done.
fix.filedReview: You review the pull request when it's done.
fix.title: Fix in code
fix.description: {{who}} gets this computer's log as a ticket, finds the causes in Godmode's code and fixes them, with tests.
fix.noRepo: Which repository? Add Godmode's source repository (or your fork) under Self-repair first.
fix.notePlaceholder: Optional, e.g. “Chats stop after a few minutes”
fix.mergeOn: No review step: the pull request is merged as soon as the fix is delivered.
fix.mergeOff: The pull request waits for your review.

board.archiveAll_one: Archive {{count}} — off the board, never deleted
board.archiveAll_other: Archive all {{count}} — off the board, never deleted
board.quickAddHint: Enter to add · Esc to close

dialog.waitUpload: Wait for the upload to finish
dialog.waitUploadDescription: Then close — the task is kept as a draft.
dialog.srDescription: Give the task a title and a description — paste or drop images, PDFs and files into it.
dialog.title: Title
dialog.descriptionPlaceholder: Add a description… Paste or drop screenshots and files, type - for a list or [] for a checklist.
dialog.repoHint: The task gets its own git worktree on a new branch. Godmode opens a pull request when the agent is done — with your own git and GitHub CLI login.
dialog.repoHintWithTip: Tip: add repositories to the workspace to pick them here. The task gets its own git worktree on a new branch. Godmode opens a pull request when the agent is done — with your own git and GitHub CLI login.
dialog.willStart: {{name}} will start working right after creation.
dialog.attachTitle: Attach images, PDFs or other files

editor.heading: Heading
editor.attachHint: or paste / drop them into the text

sheet.uploadPending: The file is still on its way into the description.
sheet.archivedBanner: Archived {{when}} — off the board, nothing is lost.
sheet.autoMergeLabel: Merge the pull request by itself once delivered
sheet.partGoal: A part serves its ticket's goal
sheet.descriptionPlaceholder: Details, acceptance criteria, links… Type # for a heading, - for a list, [] for a checklist.
sheet.savesAsYouType: Saves as you type · paste or drop screenshots and files

parts.title: Parts
parts.hint: Split the work: each part is a ticket of its own, and this one waits until they're finished.

github.pushAndOpenLabel: Push the branch and open it on GitHub
github.pushChangesHint: Push the latest changes and open a pull request into {{branch}}
github.pushBranchHint: Push the branch and open a pull request into {{branch}}

reply.changePr: What should {{name}} change? The pull request updates.
reply.readsLater: Message {{name}} — it reads it when this run is done
reply.reopens: Something still missing? Tell {{name}} — the task reopens.

page.assignToStart: Assign an agent to start it
page.prMergedDone: Pull request #{{number}} is merged and the ticket is done.
page.queuedToMergeDescription: The ticket moves to Done once GitHub merges it.
page.title: Agent tasks
page.descriptionScoped: {{scope}} — tickets you hand to your agents.
page.descriptionGlobal: Global tasks — tickets you hand to your agents.
page.descriptionAll: Every workspace's board of tickets you hand to your agents.
page.archivedInfo_one: <n>{{count}}</n> archived · restoring puts a task back on top of its column
page.archivedInfo_other: <n>{{count}}</n> archived · restoring puts a task back on top of its column
page.noMatchDescription: Nothing on this board fits the filters.
page.deleteText: The task is gone for good. The agent's conversation is kept.
page.deleteTextBranch: The task is gone for good and its worktree is removed (a pushed branch and pull request stay). The agent's conversation is kept.
page.deleteArchiveHint: To just get it off the board, archive it — you can restore it anytime.

takeOff.title: Take {{who}} off #{{number}}?
takeOff.text: The run stops and the task is parked in the Backlog.

handOver.title: Hand #{{number}} to {{next}}?
handOver.text: {{who}} is still on it. {{ends}} and {{next}} starts over.

text.archive: {{who}} is still working on #{{number}}. Archiving it stops the run and parks the task in the Backlog.
text.move: {{who}} is still working on #{{number}}. Moving it to {{status}} stops the run.

text.archive: {{who}} is waiting for your answer on #{{number}}. Archiving it ends the run and parks the task in the Backlog — it can't be continued afterwards.
text.move: {{who}} is waiting for your answer on #{{number}}. Moving it to {{status}} ends the run — it can't be continued afterwards.

text.archive: #{{number}} waits for Claude's {{limit}} to reset. Archiving it ends the run and parks the task in the Backlog — it can't be continued afterwards.
text.move: #{{number}} waits for Claude's {{limit}} to reset. Moving it to {{status}} ends the run — it can't be continued afterwards.

text.archive: #{{number}} is paused. Archiving it ends the run and parks the task in the Backlog — it can't be continued afterwards.
text.move: #{{number}} is paused. Moving it to {{status}} ends the run — it can't be continued afterwards.

text.archive: {{who}} plans to continue #{{number}}. Archiving it cancels that and parks the task in the Backlog.
text.move: {{who}} plans to continue #{{number}}. Moving it to {{status}} cancels that.

textWhen.archive: {{who}} plans to continue #{{number}} {{when}}. Archiving it cancels that and parks the task in the Backlog.
textWhen.move: {{who}} plans to continue #{{number}} {{when}}. Moving it to {{status}} cancels that.
